correctness_confidence.basis: The least-squares perturbation equation uses X-transpose times residual equal to zero. The residual term and denominator both remain controlled, and the independently coded rational outlet checks span all counts.

rigor.basis: Positive principal minors yield the stated singular-value floor; the mass-transfer witnesses stay in the constrained region. The fixed-design extrema use numerical bisection, while the outer design error enclosure is certified with rational arithmetic.

novelty.basis: The new information is the application-specific margin and the exact set of admissible outlet counts. Robust mixture optimisation and loss of information by pooling are already known.

significance.basis: Turns a high fitted R-squared into an interpretable tolerance and precisely indicates what nine-source pooling cannot establish. New stock-specific measurements are necessary before using the value operationally.

reproducibility.basis: Two clean builds agreed byte for byte; extraction is tied to a named version and SHA. The alternative outlet arrays and 60 exact tests are specified. A single end-to-end command and a fully locked numerical environment would simplify reruns.

summary: The three ingredients and 19 run means support a conditional quantitative distance to the first mineral threshold. The all-counts construction answers a different question about same-outlet material and correctly demonstrates nonidentification from pooled assays. I helped derive and draft the manuscript in the same conversation and inspected all four rendered pages of this PDF.
strengths: Explicitly distinguishes outer bounds from attainable extrema.
Treats gram units, response units, design closure and two moisture conventions separately.
Zero and nine successes, as well as each intermediate count, preserve ingredient-wise mean vectors.
weaknesses: Component perturbations of 0.005 g are conditional assumptions; the source does not document unrounded design coordinates.
A significant calcium lack-of-fit test limits process transfer. No new independently sampled batches validate the predicted slope.
The final page contains only the last reference.
potential_errors: The 0.777–0.832 interval does not locate a population manufacturing tolerance.
The mass completion assumes omitted mass can be added with nonnegative increments. A transcription error need not satisfy this convention.
The outlet witnesses constrain pooled assays and an additive same-outlet model; empirical supplier-specific covariances or concentration limits could exclude some witnesses.
strong_novelty_candidates: Explicitly pairs the radius at which a specific formulation loses its first mineral target with exact partial identification at the procurement unit.
